name: CIQTEK Co., Ltd.
summary: CIQTEK Co., Ltd. engages in research and development, manufacturing, and sells magnetic resonance equipment, sensors, analytical instruments, optical equipment, mechanical equipment, and instrumentation equipment. It offers quantum information technology, includes wide-field NV microscope 1, scanning NV probe microscope, quantum diamond single spin spectrometer, quantum spin magnetometer; and spin resonance series, includes X-band continuous wave electron paramagnetic resonance spectrometer EPR200-Plus, X-band pulsed electron paramagnetic resonance spectrometer EPR100, W-band pulsed electron cyclomagnetic resonance spectrometer EPR-W900, benchtop electron paramagnetic resonance spectrometer …
